DELETE /api/library/cleanup/rejections/{.reason: Adds authenticated removal of a saved cleanup rejection. This clears only the review decision; it never deletes media or changes authored metadata. No playback or Baton contract change.

GET /api/library/cleanup/rejections#oper.reason: Adds an authenticated, paginated, literal-search pool of retained file, folder and metadata rejections with current-evidence status. Existing cleanup and playback routes are unchanged; Baton does not consume this authoring endpoint.

POST /api/library/cleanup/rejections#ope.reason: Adds authenticated storage of a bounded cleanup proposal and its evidence identity after a transactional indexed-context check. Rejecting never writes media or tags. Existing apply, journal and rollback contracts remain authoritative.

POST /api/library/cleanup/rejections/mat.reason: Adds authenticated matching of at most 100 cleanup proposals against saved rejection fingerprints. Changed values or evidence do not match; this read-only decision check does not change playback or native client DTOs.

POST /api/library/cleanup/rejections/{id.reason: Adds authenticated restoration of a saved proposal into unchecked browser review after a fresh transactional indexed-context check. Stale proposals remain retained and return conflict. Restoration removes only the rejection; explicit apply still uses the existing coordinator, journal and rollback.
